children: US community bank's Q3 net income and EPS fell yr/yr due to higher credit loss provision and expenses
Net interest income nearly doubled, driven by merger with Farmers Bancorp
Results include $3 mln in merger-related expenses and $1.6 mln preliminary bargain purchase gain
Company says focus remains on integration of Farmers Bancorp and realizing merger benefits
Company says it is monitoring credit risk amid inflation, market volatility and geopolitical risks
CREDIT LOSS PROVISION - Co said higher provision for credit losses, including charge-offs on commercial loans, reduced net income
MERGER EXPENSES - Co reported $3 mln in nonrecurring merger-related expenses tied to Farmers Bancorp acquisition
MERGER IMPACT - Net interest income rose sharply due to expanded assets and liabilities from Farmers Bancorp merger
